findings.highlight: I can now play this song from start to finish
findings.evidenceJa: 通しで弾こうとしても、未だに二、三箇所は止まってしまう
findings.explanation: Haruki says that even when he tries to play straight through, he still stops in two or three places. The translation first asserts that he can play start to finish, directly contradicting the limitation.
findings.japanese:
通しで弾こうとしても、
未だに二、三箇所は止まってしまう今の俺にとって、
弾き飽きるなんてことはまったく未知の領域だった。
findings.todokanai: Even though I can now play this song from start to finish, I still tend to pause in two or three places, so I'm far from the point where I can actually feel tired of playing this song.

findings.highlight: whenever I finish a song, she immediately wants to hear the next one
findings.evidenceJa: 演奏が止まってしまうと、すぐに再開を促す
findings.explanation: Whenever Haruki's playing stops, Setsuna immediately urges him to resume. The translation makes him finish songs normally and her request successive songs, deleting music's function of preventing silence.
findings.japanese:
だから雪菜は、俺のギターの音色を求める。
演奏が止まってしまうと、すぐに再開を促す。
findings.todokanai: That's why Setsuna wants to hear the sound of my guitar. That's why whenever I finish a song, she immediately wants to hear the next one.

findings.highlight: your Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday girlfriends
findings.evidenceJa: 月曜の彼女と火曜の彼女が水曜に鉢合わせ？
findings.explanation: The joke is that the Monday girlfriend and Tuesday girlfriend run into each other on Wednesday. The translation invents a third, Wednesday girlfriend and breaks the calendar setup.
findings.japanese:
「なに？　修羅場？
月曜の彼女と火曜の彼女が水曜に鉢合わせ？」
findings.todokanai: "What? Is there a fight going on inside? Did your Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday girlfriends happen to meet each other?"

findings.highlight: I spent the day wandering aimlessly and was just about ready to give up.
findings.evidenceJa: 途方に暮れて傷だらけの指を見つめたあの日
findings.explanation: Haruki recalls the day he stared at his battered fingers in despair over the missing instruments and vocalist. The translation invents a day of wandering and nearly giving up, deleting the concrete finger-and-guitar callback.
findings.japanese:
ギターしかいない、
ベースもドラムもボーカルすらもアテのない、
途方に暮れて傷だらけの指を見つめたあの日。
findings.todokanai: With only guitarists in the groupーwithout a bassist, a drummer, or a singerーI had no idea where to even start. I spent the day wandering aimlessly and was just about ready to give up.

findings.highlight: I've been keeping an eye on you since then, Setsuna. It's also one of the reasons why I asked you to take her spot.
findings.evidenceJa: あの頃からずっと雪菜を意識してたんだろうな。彼女の後釜に雪菜が座ったことも理由の一つかも
findings.explanation: Haruki speculates that Tomo had been conscious of Setsuna since then, perhaps partly because Setsuna occupied the successor position after her. The translation makes Haruki the watcher and invents that he asked Setsuna to take Tomo's spot.
findings.japanese:
「あの頃からずっと雪菜を意識してたんだろうな。
彼女の後釜に雪菜が座ったことも理由の一つかも」
findings.todokanai: "I've been keeping an eye on you since then, Setsuna. It's also one of the reasons why I asked you to take her spot."

findings.highlight: people who I can speak ill of nonchalantly
findings.evidenceJa: 人の嫌がることをズバズバ言うコ
findings.explanation: Setsuna objects to a girl who bluntly says things other people hate hearing. The translation makes Setsuna the person who can speak ill of those people, reversing the speaker of the offensive remarks.
findings.japanese:
「や、やめてよもう！　今寒気がしちゃったよ！
あんなに人の嫌がることをズバズバ言うコなんて
こっちから願い下げだよ！」
findings.todokanai: "D-Don't say that, jeez! You just gave me the chills! I'd rather not have to deal with people who I can speak ill of nonchalantly like that!"

findings.highlight: guaranteed to graduate
findings.evidenceJa: 進級も約束されたようなもの
findings.explanation: The notes supposedly guarantee advancement to the next academic year, not graduation.
findings.japanese:
「そんなことないってマジで！
何しろ六年間も使い続けてきた信頼品質だ。
これで俺の進級も約束されたようなもの」
findings.todokanai: "No way! I've been using this product for the past six years, so I can guarantee its quality. When I'm using these notes, I feel like I'm guaranteed to graduate!"

findings.highlight: The snack he ate with his tea
findings.evidenceJa: お茶請けっぽく置かれているピンクのリボンがついた紙包み
findings.explanation: A paper package tied with a pink ribbon sits there like a tea snack while Haruki avoids looking at it. The translation calls it a snack Takeya ate, inventing consumption and misidentifying the package.
findings.japanese:
そこにお茶請けっぽく置かれている
ピンクのリボンがついた紙包みを
必死で視界からそらしつつ…
findings.todokanai: I tried my best to avoid looking at it… The snack he ate with his tea, the bag with the pink ribbon on it…

findings.highlight: A question I ask about my sheet music and my parental bond
findings.evidenceJa: 楽譜も、親子の情愛も、なぁ…
findings.explanation: Haruki ruefully pairs the missing sheet music with missing parent-child affection. The English turns the parallel noun fragments into an unexplained question and obscures the proposition.
findings.japanese: 楽譜も、親子の情愛も、なぁ…
findings.todokanai: A question I ask about my sheet music and my parental bond…

findings.highlight: do you want me to fail them or something?
findings.evidenceJa: 俺一浪くらいならいいよね？
findings.explanation: Haruki asks his mother whether spending one year as a ronin to retake entrance examinations would be acceptable. The translation instead accuses her of wanting him to fail, changing both the academic fact and the speech act.
findings.japanese: 「…母さん俺一浪くらいならいいよね？」
findings.todokanai: "Mom… do you want me to fail them or something?"

findings.highlight: the honeymoon period
findings.evidenceJa: 今さら発情期ってのもなぁ
findings.explanation: Haruki crudely jokes that his parents are going into heat or rut at their age. 'Honeymoon period' sanitizes the sexual-animal register and changes the joke.
findings.japanese:
「今さら発情期ってのもなぁ…
ホント、あの二人っていつまでも仲いいよな」
findings.todokanai: "I guess this is what they call the honeymoon period… Those two are always so close."

findings.highlight: we suddenly fell into a slump, overwhelmed by our emotions and memories
findings.evidenceJa: 急に自己完結して落ち込んでいく『思い出しへこみ』
findings.explanation: This is Setsuna's recurring pattern of abruptly closing the loop inside herself and sinking when something triggers a memory. The translation makes both speakers jointly slump and loses the named behavioral pattern.
findings.japanese:
さっきまではしゃいでたはずなのに、
何かのきっかけがあると急に自己完結して
落ち込んでいく『思い出しへこみ』。
findings.todokanai: Although we were having a wonderful conversation just now, like on cue, we suddenly fell into a slump, overwhelmed by our emotions and memories.

findings.highlight: My graduation has already been guaranteed
findings.evidenceJa: とっくに進級は確定してる
findings.explanation: Setsuna says advancement to the next year is already assured, not graduation.
findings.japanese:
「わ、わたしも…
わたしも、とっくに進級は確定してる！」
findings.todokanai: "M-Me too! My graduation has already been guaranteed too!"

findings.highlight: If I stay chained to you
findings.evidenceJa: あなたを繋ぎ止めたまま
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she may keep Haruki tied to her while remaining unable to move. The translation makes Setsuna the person chained to Haruki, reversing who is binding whom in her confession of guilt.
findings.japanese:
「そうやって、あなたを繋ぎ止めたまま、
ずっとどこにも行けずに立ちすくんだままかも」
findings.todokanai: "If I stay chained to you like that, I'll probably always stand still, without ever being able to move anywhere…"

findings.highlight: Finals are about to start
findings.evidenceJa: 試験の真っ最中にまで
findings.explanation: Finals are already in full swing, not about to begin.
findings.japanese:
「…呆れてるのよ。
あんたたち、試験の真っ最中にまで、
そんなおままごと続けてんの？」
findings.todokanai: "…Of course I'm taken aback. Finals are about to start and you two are still fooling around like that?"

findings.highlight: If you want a man to show you affection, you have to take some desperate measures. If you're interested in him, go embrace him
findings.evidenceJa: 男が気を引こうと必死こいてるんだから、そいつに気があるなら女は抱かれてあげる
findings.explanation: Io says the man is desperately trying to win the woman's attention, and if she likes him she should let him take her to bed or embrace her. The translation makes the woman desperate and tells her to initiate the embrace, reversing both pursuit and sexual agency.
findings.japanese:
「男が気を引こうと必死こいてるんだから、
そいつに気があるなら女は抱かれてあげるんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "If you want a man to show you affection, you have to take some desperate measures. If you're interested in him, go embrace him, girl."

findings.highlight: I'm not particularly happy with some parts I played here and there
findings.evidenceJa: ところどころに自分の赤が入ってた
findings.explanation: The handwritten score has Haruki's own red annotations or corrections in places. The translation invents dissatisfaction with parts he played and loses the material trace by which the old score carries his participation.
findings.japanese:
ところどころに自分の赤が入ってた、
たった一日しか練習しなかった…
findings.todokanai: I'm not particularly happy with some parts I played here and there, but then again, I only had one day to practice…

findings.highlight: Noーto Setsuna, it might take an eternity until it isn't too soon for this song.
findings.evidenceJa:
いや、もしかしたら雪菜にとっては
“永遠に早すぎる”曲なのかもしれない。
findings.explanation: ‘It might take an eternity until it isn't too soon’ is tortured English and can suggest eventual readiness where 永遠に早すぎる means eternally too soon.
findings.japanese:
いや、もしかしたら雪菜にとっては
“永遠に早すぎる”曲なのかもしれない。
findings.todokanai: Noーto Setsuna, it might take an eternity until it isn't too soon for this song.

findings.highlight: that's not quite the reason why I stopped playing it willingly
findings.evidenceJa: 俺がそれを自分から止めるのは違うと思った
findings.explanation: Haruki decides it would be wrong for him to stop the song or the confrontation with memory of his own accord. The translation says he did stop voluntarily and merely disputes the reason, reversing the decision.
findings.japanese: でも、俺がそれを自分から止めるのは違うと思ったから。
findings.todokanai: Nevertheless, that's not quite the reason why I stopped playing it willingly.

findings.highlight: I'm doing my best in desperately removing whatever Setsuna doesn't want to see from her sight
findings.evidenceJa: 必死で見せないように努力するのは、俺のするべきことじゃない
findings.explanation: Haruki says desperately hiding from Setsuna whatever she averts her eyes from is not his role. The translation says he is actively doing exactly that, reversing the policy that motivates his use of the song.
findings.japanese:
雪菜が目をそらしているものを、
必死で見せないように努力するのは、
俺のするべきことじゃないって思ったから…
findings.todokanai: And even though I know it's not what I should be doing, I'm doing my best in desperately removing whatever Setsuna doesn't want to see from her sight.

findings.highlight: in the past few days, we've made a bit of progress
findings.evidenceJa: ここ数日で、ほんの少しは進展が見られるかもしれないという予感
findings.explanation: Setsuna's voice gives Haruki a premonition that the next few days may bring some progress. The translation turns that future possibility into progress already made over the past few days.
findings.japanese:
もしかしたらここ数日で、
ほんの少しは進展が見られるかもしれないという予感が、
じわじわと湧き上がってくる、雪菜の柔らかい声。
findings.todokanai: Listening to Setsuna's soothing voice, I couldn't help but excitedly think that in the past few days, we've made a bit of progress.

findings.highlight: she has to be careful so as to not unintentionally say anything hurtful
findings.evidenceJa: 意図しない言葉の刃で削り合うとき
findings.explanation: Haruki contrasts Tomo's stress release with the way he and Setsuna scrape and wound each other using unintended blades of language. The translation describes Setsuna carefully avoiding hurtful words, the opposite interaction.
findings.japanese: …俺と、意図しない言葉の刃で削り合うときとは対照的に。
findings.todokanai: …It's a stark contrast to how she speaks with me at least, where she has to be careful so as to not unintentionally say anything hurtful.

findings.highlight: Just then… it crossed my mind.
findings.evidenceJa: その時までは…そう思ってたんだ
findings.explanation: Haruki says that until that moment, he had believed Tomo might be a good frenemy for Setsuna; the phrasing foreshadows the imminent collapse of that belief. The translation merely repeats that the thought occurred then.
findings.japanese: その時までは…そう思ってたんだ。
findings.todokanai: Just then… it crossed my mind.

findings.highlight: after her second consecutive year of participating
findings.evidenceJa: 去年に引き続き二度目の登場となる
findings.explanation: The DJ says Tomo is making her second appearance on the program, following last year's appearance. The translation turns this into a second consecutive year of pageant participation.
findings.japanese:
「はい、ということで、今日のゲストは
去年に引き続き二度目の登場となる、今年度ミス峰城大、
柳原朋ちゃんにお越しいただきました」
findings.todokanai: "Thank you, that wraps things up. Our guest today was Yanagihara Tomo-chan, who won the title of Miss Houjou University this year after her second consecutive year of participating!"
